title: fleet parking_lot row v1
description: ONE ROW OF THE parking_lot TABLE (work-data-ssot-audit-2026-10-19, target schema, parking): one park, with its own time; a later park is a new lot. The columns are the audit's, so the row moves into the future fleet.db unchanged. A column that is not known is left out, never null. The row is the one row of rows in <HORDE_HOME>/fleet/hibernations/<hid>/parking_lot.json (fleet/LotTables.ps1).

id.description: A ULID whose time is created_at; the folder <hid> (yyyymmdd-hhmmss) is that same time.

created_at.description: When it was parked, UTC to the second.

created_by_session_id.description: The session that parked, when it is known.

created_by_orc_id.description: The Orc that parked, as the orc table's id, when it is known.

selection_kind.description: How the sessions were chosen: all (fleet record -All), labels (fleet record -Labels), orcs (fleet hibernate), backfill (written from a file for a park that happened before lots existed).
